department: School of Medicine and Dentistry biomedical sciences PhD programs

deadline.value: Complete application due December 1 (some programs accept until January 1 at their discretion); applying by November 15 waives the fee.

app_fee.value: USD 60 (Epidemiology and Health Services Research apply via SOPHAS at USD 100).
app_fee.quote: By December 1st* - Complete application due ($60 application fee applies).

fee_waiver.value: Applications submitted by November 15, 2026 get an automatic waiver; hardship waivers can be requested later.
fee_waiver.quote: Applications submitted by November 15* receive an automatic waiver.

gre_general.value: The GRE is optional for all School of Medicine and Dentistry PhD programs; some programs ignore submitted scores.
gre_general.quote: Completion of the Graduate Record Examination (GRE) is optional for all PhD programs in the University of Rochester School of Medicine and Dentistry.

english_waiver.value: Waiver possible for a bachelor's from a country where English is an official language and all instruction is in English, with at least six full semesters in good standing; India's eligibility is not stated.
english_waiver.quote: from an accredited college or university in a country where English is an official language and where all instruction is provided in English. | A minimum of six full semesters of academic coursework in good standing is required to qualify for a waiver

supervisor.value: Biomedical science PhD students begin with lab rotations and choose a lab afterwards.
supervisor.quote: Students entering the University of Rochester School of Medicine and Dentistry via a biomedical science PhD program have the option of beginning a first lab rotation on July 1.

funding.value: The fellowship package for full-time students is a full tuition scholarship, a stipend ($35,800 for 12-month programs in 2027-28) and health insurance.
funding.quote: Fellowship Package for Full-time Students Full tuition scholarship, including all academic fees.

entry_route.value: A bachelor's degree (US equivalent) is the stated requirement.
entry_route.quote: Applicants must have earned a U.S. baccalaureate degree or its equivalent from a college, university, or technical school of acceptable standing.

gre_subject.value: No GRE Subject Test exists for this field; ETS offers Subject Tests only in Mathematics, Physics and Psychology.
gre_subject.quote: The GRE Subject Tests in Mathematics, Physics and Psychology measure undergraduate achievement in a particular field of study

notes: Umbrella record for the School of Medicine and Dentistry PhDs (Biochemistry, Genetics, Biophysics, Pharmacology/Physiology, Immunology/Microbiology, Pathology, Toxicology, Translational Biomedical Science); one application to one program per year.
